blocks.x: The honest pitch for cloud security & posture management fits in a sentence — Secure at the control plane — posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform. — and the rest of this page is the how: measured baseline, bounded build, evidence in flight.

Cloud security is won at the control plane: landing-zone guardrails, policy-as-code (Terraform/Open Policy Agent) that blocks misconfiguration before deploy, CSPM scanning with fix-the-pipeline workflows rather than alert spam. We implement the full stack — CNAPP-class posture management, workload runtime security, secrets management (Vault-class), and data security with classification-aware DLP and encryption/key policy (KMS, BYOK, HSM-backed).

The differentiator is developer adoption: guardrails that fail builds with actionable messages, golden modules that make the secure path the easy path, and exceptions with expiry. Security reviews stop being bottlenecks because 90% of posture issues never reach review — they were prevented in the pipeline.

The sectors where Cloud Security & Posture Management currently runs: Technology & SaaS, Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Retail & Consumer Goods. Each engagement anchors to one named metric in that sector's own language.
